csv_scope_of_work: The City of Wildwood is seeking qualifications from architectural firms or individual practitioners, licensed and practicing in the State of Missouri to provide professional design review services in conjunction with its Department of Planning and Planning and Zoning Commission. The selected firm or consultant will evaluate all development proposals within the Town Center Area, institutional uses outside this special area of the City, and other building or structure types, as set forth within the City s Zoning Ordinance, while proposals submitted within the City s Town Center Area are expected to adhere to its New Urbanism and Prefubria design standards and its specific architectural guidelines
